patches.expected_before: For any $\theta\in\Theta_a(Q)$, the sequence $r_j=\theta_j^2$ belongs to $\mathcal C$. Step 3.1 bounds its omitted squared norm. The cutoff risk is that tail plus the retained variance by [F4], so at the cutoff $D$ from step 2.1 its worst-case risk is at most $\sum_{j>D}r_j^*+2\sum_{j\le D}\tau_j^2=2J_*$. Therefore $R_{\rm cut}(\epsilon)^2\le2J_*$.
